note: This file records how the dataset `vlmrerank-8b-failed` was built. The review tool and the match runner do not read this file and do not write it. Rule: a photo is selected when its label in the source run is `positive` and its true slug is not at rank 1 of that run. An absent true slug has `rank_of_truth` null and counts as not at rank 1. A selected photo is copied when its label in `default` is still `positive` on the build day. The photo file and its label entry are copied without a change. The dataset is a frozen copy: a later change of a label in `default` does not reach it. `source_query_id` is the query id of the photo in the source run. A run of this dataset gives new query ids, so join the two runs on `image_path`.
